conflict_resolution: Identify the exact artifacts and the type of claim in conflict.
Use normative order for requested behavior and observational order for claims about what has been proven.
Prefer an explicit later revision only when the revision relationship is recorded.
Do not modify benchmark inputs, tests, or evidence merely to remove a conflict.
Record an open decision or actionable escalation when higher authority does not resolve the conflict.

derived_and_advisory.rule: Regenerate from its authoritative source; do not hand-edit when a generator exists.
Untrusted implementation input until adoption review and provenance gates pass.
Must remain labeled and cannot silently become a requirement.

normative_order.rule: Controls how autonomous work is performed. A later explicit operator directive may revise it for the stated scope.

locations: canonical source files referenced by source IDs

normative_order.rule: Overrides earlier source only when the revision relationship is explicit.
Resolves accepted design choices within higher authority.
Defines accepted testable obligations and authority classification.
Defines implementation strategy and stable plan sections.
Tracks execution state; it does not create or revise requirements by itself.

observational_order.rule: Best proof of an observed claim when identity, method, result, environment, freshness, and digest are valid.
Proves only the behavior and environment actually exercised.
Code presence is not proof of acceptance or live operation.
Status is coordination data, not completion evidence.
